hardware: Apple M5 Max, 32 GPU cores, 18 CPU cores, 36 GB RAM
final_changes: History projection fsync on segment close/clean shutdown; no periodic 100 ms / 8 MiB projection fsync. RocksDB synchronous WAL unchanged.
SQLite indexer reads a consistent bounded RocksDB snapshot without the Node mutex.
Native MLX cooperative crossover 2048 -> 2560; arithmetic and 4096-record direct path unchanged.
baseline: Candidate at start of this investigation, including the previous Capnp/local-validation/shared-hash/async block-read changes; not a clean Git commit.
final_method: Four before/after pairs; order AB, BA, AB, BA. Rust release, MLX native, 1048576 transfers, rpc_batch 4096, inflight 1, interval 10 ms, TCP, one node, SQLite ON, 12 Rayon threads. Signing/preparation excluded; verification, execution and durable commit included. SQLite catch-up measured separately. No diagnostic probes in either final binary.

validation.indexer_concurrency: catch-up completes while execution mutex remains held

limitations: A low-throughput run remains after the change. Four short pairs do not establish sustained capacity or a reliable tail distribution.
The median paired improvement and ratio of medians differ because runs occupy fast and slow modes; report both rather than cherry-picking one.
Traces localize waits to storage synchronization; no block-device tracing identifies the physical OS/device cause of variable fsync latency.
History projection crash recovery can require reconstructing more bytes; authoritative synchronous RocksDB durability is unchanged.
GPU crossover measured on M5 Max; not a throughput claim for other hardware, contracts or multi-host networks.
diagnostic_exclusions: gpu-range-2048.jsonl and gpu-range-4096.jsonl were affected by shared-target workspace artifact reuse and were superseded by the explicitly rebuilt gpu-range-fresh runs.
All traced, ablation, prototype and persistent trials are separate from the final paired summary.
reproduction: RAYON_NUM_THREADS=12 target/release/sfc-bench bench --binary /path/to/sfc --transactions 1048576 --rpc-batch 4096 --inflight 1 --interval 10 --repeat 1 --sqlite on --output /tmp/result.capnp; alternate retained before/after release binaries.
